jobs.title: Visual Designer, AI Trainer
jobs.description:
Visual Designer, AI Trainer (Remote, Flexible Hours)

100% Remote | Work When You Want | Part-Time or Full-Time | Freelance Contract | $40 to $125 per hour

Fully remote. Work when you want. Get paid for what you already know. Applying takes just a few minutes with your resume.

We are partnering with DataAnnotation to find experienced visual designers to work as remote AI trainers and evaluate how frontier AI models handle real design work: interfaces, layouts, typography and visual systems. You bring the eye you have built over a career of shipping design. You design a realistic brief from your own practice, such as a landing page, a pitch deck, a data visualization, a poster or a motion piece, run it through frontier AI design tools and judge what comes back against a professional standard. This is project-based, 100% remote work you do from home on your own schedule, alongside a current job, including evenings and weekends.

Already have a DataAnnotation account?
This opportunity runs through our partnership with DataAnnotation. If you have already taken a DataAnnotation starter assessment, you are not eligible to apply through this posting. If you created an account but never took the assessment, you can still apply.

What the Work Involves

Design challenging, realistic design briefs drawn from your own professional work
Run those briefs through frontier AI design tools and evaluate the output against the standard you would hold a colleague to
Compare two model versions on the same prompts and assets, decide which performed better and where each fell short
Critique model-generated interfaces, mockups, layouts, slides, infographics, illustrations and motion
Flag concrete failures with evidence: alignment and spacing, content overflow and cutoff, typography, visual hierarchy, SVG and illustration quality, ignored assets, off-brief interpretation

Areas of Expertise

The work spans these areas; depth in at least one is what matters:
UI/UX, web and product design
Office and presentation design
Graphic design and branding
Technical illustration and data visualization
Motion and new media

Who This Is For

Professional background in UI/UX design, web design, product design or graphic design
Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, layout, typography, interaction design and user flow
Able to articulate why a design fails, not only that it does
Comfortable with AI design tools, or able to pick them up quickly
A current, in-progress or completed bachelor's degree is preferred but not required
Fluent written English at a native or bilingual level
Comfortable working independently, following detailed written instructions and incorporating feedback

Pay, Hours and Location

Pay:
$40 to $125 per hour, depending on project and expertise. Bonus rates are available on some projects. Paid via PayPal on a regular schedule. You are paid for every step you complete
Hours:
Work whenever it suits you, including evenings and weekends. Minimum 10 hours per week with no maximum; full-time hours are available. Choose which projects you work on and when
Location:
100% remote, work from home. Must be based in the United States, Canada, or the UK
Tools:
Access to the AI models you will evaluate is provided; no personal subscription needed

How to Apply

Apply here with your resume. It takes just a few minutes, and there are no interviews
We review your background against the role
If it's a fit, we send you a link to take DataAnnotation's skills assessment. It's unpaid, takes about 1 to 2+ hours and tests domain judgment and careful reading. The assessment must be entirely your own work; AI-assisted submissions are detected and rejected

If you pass, you complete onboarding and a short training project, then propose and build tasks from your own professional experience, with expert review and written feedback at each stage

Crucial Recruiting and Sidebar Talent are working together on this search in partnership with DataAnnotation.

jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Description
TSD Engineering, Inc. is a land development firm specializing in civil engineering and surveying services for a wide range of projects. The company manages work across Northern and Central California as well as Nevada, offering expertise in diverse site conditions and regulatory environments. Projects range from custom home lots to large residential subdivisions, multi-family complexes, and commercial developments. Team members collaborate closely with clients, jurisdictions, and other consultants to deliver efficient, buildable, and cost-effective solutions. The firm provides opportunities to work on varied project types and develop broad technical and project management skills.
Role Description
The Civil Engineer will support land development projects through the design and analysis of site infrastructure, including grading, utilities, roadways, and stormwater systems. Day-to-day responsibilities include preparing civil engineering plans and reports, coordinating with survey staff, assisting in project planning and permitting, and responding to plan check comments from reviewing agencies. The role involves working with senior engineers and project managers to develop design solutions, perform calculations, and ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Folsom, CA, requiring regular collaboration with internal teams and external stakeholders to keep projects on schedule and within budget.
Qualifications

Ability to perform Civil Engineering Design and apply core Civil Engineering principles to land development projects.
Experience working as part of a team of Civil Engineers, including coordination with surveyors and other disciplines.
Skills in Planning related to site layout, entitlement processes, and coordination with agencies and clients.
Knowledge of Stormwater Management, including drainage design, hydrology/hydraulics calculations, and compliance with applicable regulations.
Proficiency with CAD and civil design software (e.g., AutoCAD Civil 3D or similar) and standard office productivity tools.
Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related field; EIT certification preferred, PE license or path to licensure is a plus.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and quality of work.
Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment.
